published_ranges._notes: Product page: nozzle 235+C, 'We print up to 275 C, but 255 C is a good compromise'. Use Magigoo or glue to avoid fusing to the plate. Can build up on the nozzle; reduce flow below 100% or add a nozzle wipe. Density from PETG Colors SDS.

conflicts: Joel's Highfive Blue and Blood of My Enemies Red PETG pages, and the White PETG feature list, give 'processing from 230+ C @ 2 cu mm/s' (https://proto-pasta.com/products/joels-highfive-blue-petg)
